title: How can I close a credit card account?
summary: This document explains how to close a Rho-Bank credit card account: balance must be $0.00, no active/pending disputes, account age at least 60 days, and no pending replacement card orders. It also covers 45 days to redeem unredeemed rewards and a full annual fee refund if closure is within 37 days of annual fee posting.
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements to close my Rho-Bank credit card account?
How do pending transactions or disputes affect my ability to request closure?
How long do I have to redeem unredeemed rewards after submitting a closure request?
When is my annual fee refundable if I close the account?
Will closing my credit card account affect my credit score, and how?
What should I do if I have a replacement card ordered but not yet received or activated?
